result.title: Anthropic IPOs, GPT 6.2 Astra Arrives, But There’s a Bigger Story
result.description:
GPT 6.2 Astra is OpenAI’s best model, so for each of the last 4 years this would have been the only headline. But now Gemini is catching up fast, with 4 Carbon and Neon, and Anthropic are IPO-ing after promising imminent RSI. And even all this isn’t quite the main story, is it? We now have data on what drives model improvement, how close AI is to automating AI, and whether, as Dario Amodei of Anthropic promised, we are witnessing a ‘race to the top’...
